title: Music director of the Zanzibar and his own Zanzibar Orchestra
summary: After three months with Armstrong at the Zanzibar, McRae led the small dance band and tightened the floor show for owner Howard.

bands.name: Teddy McRae and His Zanzibar Orchestra

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Let's back up a bit. We skipped something that you did back in 1946. Teddy McRae and his Zanzibar Orchestra. Do you remember that?
You made some records for Queen Records and also, I guess -- Was Queen a part of King Records, or, what happened to them? They have the same catalog number but --

That was -- you know, when I came out of the three months with Louie at the Zanzibar, I went back as -- Claude Hopkins went back in the Zanzibar. And I went in as the music director and had charge of the small band that played the dance music between shows. And I was so -- music director for the show -- the band that Claude Hopkins played in.
